subject: Update on your application to Larkspur Consumer Co.
body:
Hi Jordan,

Thank you for applying for the Social Media Marketing Intern position at Larkspur Consumer Co. and for taking the time to speak with our team.

Unfortunately, we have decided to pursue other candidates whose experience more closely matches our needs for this internship. We will keep your resume on file and encourage you to apply again.

We wish you the best in your search.

Larkspur Consumer Co. Talent Team
